mentions.name: Time Flies – Focus Timer
mentions.description: This is a free macOS menu bar pomodoro focus timer with a tamagotchi-style companion, a polished, highly personalized take on the author's everyday apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built myself a silly little menubar pomodoro timer tamagotchi thing for mac. I’ve been slowly going through and building highly personalized versions of my day to day apps. This is the first one I polished up enough to share. Free if anyone’s interested.
